entities.summary: George Wilson Albee was a pioneering, much published and multi award-winning American clinical psychologist who believed societal factors such as unemployment, racism, sexism, and all the myriad forms of exploitation of people by people were the major cause of mental illness. He was one of the leading figures in the development of community psychology. Albee was an advocate for coping with adversity, strengthening individual resources, and social change. While there, he married Constance Impallaria, They had four children: Alec, Luke, Marina, and Sarah.
